name: launchcheck
description: Check a public website before launch for broken links, HTTP failures, launch metadata, mobile setup, basic accessibility signals, and security headers.

interface.longDescription: LaunchCheck runs a bounded, read-only preflight on a public website before launch. It checks reachability, sampled broken internal links, mobile and sharing metadata, basic accessibility signals, and important security headers, then returns evidence-backed blockers, warnings, and passes. v0.1 is a static HTTP audit: it does not execute JavaScript, click controls, submit forms, or visually inspect responsive layout.
defaultPrompt: Check this website before I launch it.
Find launch blockers and broken links on this landing page.

positive.description: Preflight a public website before launch
positive.expected_behavior: Run the bounded website audit and summarize evidence-backed blockers, warnings, and passes without claiming browser interactions.

positive.description: Sanity-check a site before sending traffic
positive.prompt: I'm about to send traffic to https://example.com. Can you sanity-check it?
positive.expected_behavior: Audit the supplied public URL and return a launch verdict with supporting evidence.

positive.description: Find broken links and launch mistakes
positive.prompt: Find broken links and obvious launch mistakes on https://example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Audit the page, sample same-origin links, and report any HTTP failures and static launch issues.

positive.prompt: Does https://example.com have the basics right for mobile and sharing?
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect viewport and sharing metadata and clearly state that v0.1 does not visually render mobile layouts.

positive.prompt: Smoke test https://example.com before tomorrow's release.
positive.expected_behavior: Run the read-only public-site preflight and return the most important issues first.

negative.prompt: Build me a landing page for my startup.
Rewrite my homepage headline to convert better.
Give me SEO keyword ideas for my product.

review.commerce_description: LaunchCheck does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial LaunchCheck v0.1: bounded read-only public website preflight with evidence-backed launch blockers, warnings, passes, sampled broken-link checks, and private-network protections.
